name: weavers-cottage-desert
description: Weaver's Cottage, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Weaver's Cottage drawn again as a dyer-weaver's house: sandstone and mud brick under a flat roof with a windcatcher, an arcade before the weaver's window, a lattice oriel over the door, dyed cloth drying on the roof, a fold under a palm-rib shade and (II) an irrigated dye garden. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
